indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_log_pkey ON public.audit_log USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_sale_items_pkey ON public.event_sale_items USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_sales_client_id_key ON public.event_sales USING btree (client_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_sales_pkey ON public.event_sales USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_pkey ON public.events USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX inventory_items_pkey ON public.inventory_items USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_entries_pkey ON public.ledger_entries USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recipe_ingredients_pkey ON public.recipe_ingredients USING btree (id)

functions.name: capacity_allows
functions.identity: p_capacity integer, p_committed integer, p_requested integer

functions.name: consume_rate_limit
functions.returns: TABLE(allowed boolean, remaining integer, reset_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.identity: p_key text, p_limit integer, p_window_s integer

functions.name: lookup_order
functions.returns: TABLE(id text, customer_name text, state order_state, pay_state pay_state, total_cents bigint, pickup_at timestamp with time zone, placed_at timestamp with time zone)

functions.name: settings_effective
functions.returns: TABLE(key text, int_value bigint, text_value text, cents_value bigint, is_default boolean)

functions.name: sync_event_sale
functions.returns: TABLE(client_id text, sale_id uuid, duplicate boolean)

functions.name: update_order_state
functions.returns: TABLE(id text, state text, pay_state text, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
functions.identity: p_order_id text, p_seen_at timestamp with time zone, p_state text, p_pay_state text, p_pay_ref text

constraints.name: audit_log_actor_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: bake_batches_drop_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (drop_id) REFERENCES drops(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: event_sale_items_sale_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (sale_id) REFERENCES event_sales(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: event_sales_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: event_sales_ledger_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (ledger_id) REFERENCES ledger_entries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: inventory_items_supplier_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: ledger_entries_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: ledger_entries_order_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: order_items_order_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: orders_drop_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (drop_id) REFERENCES drops(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: recipe_ingredients_product_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES recipes(product_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: recipes_product_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: settings_one_value
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((((int_value IS NOT NULL))::integer + ((text_value IS NOT NULL))::integer) + ((cents_value IS NOT NULL))::integer) <= 1))

constraints.name: supplier_prices_supplier_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
